# corpus-clean-fenced - Work Plan

## TL;DR (For humans)
**Who this is for:** the ULW plan author who documents examples inside the plan.
**Outcome:** fenced task-shaped lines stay examples, never executable rows.

---

> TL;DR (machine): Quick / Low；1 个实施 todo + F1；fence 内的行只是示例。

## Scope
### Affected user and ideal state
| Row | Statement | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 文档中的示例不能被当作可执行任务。 | 解析器区分 fence 边界。 |
| GAP-1 | 计划模板缺少 fence 示例。 | 1 关闭。 |

## Verification strategy
> Zero human intervention - all verification is agent-executed.
- Test decision: TDD + node:test

## Execution strategy
### Parallel execution waves
- Wave 1: task 1

## Todos
> Implementation + Test = ONE todo. Never separate.

- [ ] 1. 在计划中演示 fence 边界
  Recommended task executor category: quick — mechanical
  What to do / Must NOT do: 阅读 `lib/review-lint.js`；在文档中保留示例 fence；不修改解析器。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 1 | Blocked by: — | Blocks: F1
  References: `lib/review-lint.js:1-3`；`docs/fidelity.md`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: `node --test test/review-lint.test.mjs` 退出 0。
  QA scenarios: Happy “fenced-examples” 示例行仍只是文本。Failure “fence-leak” fence 未闭合时逐行报错。
  Commit: Y | test(corpus): fenced examples

以下示例位于 `## Todos` 中，但 fence 内的行只是文本，不是可执行任务：

```md
- [ ] 9. 示例任务：fence 内的行列不是 todo
- [ ] F8. 示例终审行：同样只是文本
```

```sh
node --test test/review-lint.test.mjs
echo "lint never executes these commands"
```

~~~json
{"version":1,"lane":"practical","verdict":"OKAY","blockers":[],"notes":["fenced example only"]}
~~~

## Final verification wave
> Runs in parallel after ALL todos.

- [ ] F1. Plan compliance audit
  Recommended task executor category: unspecified-high — audit
  What to do / Must NOT do: 只读核对每个 todo 与证据；不修改任何文件。
  Closes: GAP-1
  Parallelization: Wave 2 | Blocked by: 1 | Blocks: —
  References: `lib/review-lint.js:1-3`；`$E/task-1.txt`。
  Acceptance criteria: 每项都有证据。
  QA scenarios: Happy “audit-passes” 逐项对照证据。Failure “no-evidence” 缺证据即拒绝。
  Commit: N | 审计不单独提交

## Commit strategy
- 每个 N 项与测试一起提交。

## Success criteria
| IS | Delivering todo(s) | Proving QA scenario | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| IS-1 | 1,F1 | fenced-examples | `$E/task-1.txt` |
